mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO collection_article (collection_id, article_id, sort_order) VALUES (#{collectionId}, #{articleId}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM collection_article WHERE collection_id = #{collectionId} AND article_id = #{articleId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS id, a.title AS title FROM collection_article ca JOIN article a ON ca.article_id = a.id WHERE ca.collection_id = #{collectionId} ORDER BY ca.sort_order
